apps.name: SideInstaller
apps.subtitle: An an app that installs Sidestore on iOS 27, fully on-device
apps.localizedDescription: Install SideStore and LiveContainer directly on your iPhone. No PC required.
apps.versionDescription:
Apple fixed the patch v1.5.0, so I switched the login device to Windows and it now works
- Fixed the Apple ID login error
- This is a temporary fix, and will likely be patched by Apple as well, just like the Android in v1.5. A permanent one is in the works.
